title: Faith Whispers
text:
In silence I hear God speak
Not loud, not thunder, not demand
But soft, like breath on cheek
A gentle touch, a guiding hand

In doubt He does not shout
But waits, patient, still
Until my heart works out
The strength to climb the hill

title: Oakland Son
text:
These streets raised me
Concrete and corner stores
Grandmother's voice still in the breeze
Reminding me what I'm fighting for

I carry every lesson learned
Every fall, every rise
Every bridge that I have burned
Every truth behind the lies

title: Silence Breaks
text:
We were taught to hold it in
Swallow pain like bitter medicine
Smile through the ache within
Never show where hurt has been

But silence breaks the strongest men
Holding words that need release
So I speak, again, again
Until I finally find my peace

title: Love's Paradox
text:
You make me brave and terrified
Weak and strong in the same breath
Alive yet somehow crucified
By the thought of love and death

A hopeless romantic, yes I am
Believing when belief seems fool
Still searching for that perfect plan
Where love becomes the only rule

title: Wisdom's Weight
text:
Solomon sat on golden throne
Yet his heart was heavy stone
Knowing much brings deeper pain
Wisdom's gift, the soul's hard rain

I too have learned this bitter truth
That knowledge steals the joy of youth
But still I seek, I still must know
Even where the dark winds blow

title: Rising
text:
Every morning I decide
To stand when I could fall
To speak when I could hide
To answer destiny's call

Not perfect, not without fear
But present, here, awake
Each day another year
Of choices that I make

title: Father Questions
text:
Where were You when I called Your name
In the dark, alone, afraid?
Were You watching all the same
As I knelt down and prayed?

Your silence taught me how to listen
Your distance how to seek
In absence, truth begins to glisten
In quiet, I hear You speak
